formattedAddress: No. 192, Section 2, Neihu Rd, Hubin Village, Neihu District, Taipei City, Taiwan 114

text.text:
Just opposite Bihu Park and only a 10-minute walk from Wende MRT Station, Elephant Garden is one of the best spots for Sunday brunch.

The service is quick, with both indoor and outdoor seating available. What really makes this café special is the open space where kids can freely run and play.

We even hosted a birthday party here, and the kids had so much fun without any restrictions. There was no extra charge for using the outdoor area, which was a huge plus.

I’m so happy we chose Elephant Garden for this special day. The kids’ menu is only NT$255 — super family-friendly!

✨ If you’re looking for a relaxed, kid-friendly brunch spot in Taipei, this place is definitely worth a visit.

text.text:
Love the food and vibes here. Especially when the weather is good, outdoor seating works best!
I wasn’t expecting much of the food coz the presentation and coloring look bad, but it turned out pretty good!
This place is huge , might be a good idea for them to segment into one big area for families with kids and another small area (possibly outdoor patio) for the adults.

text.text:
The place is beautiful, its a wheelchair accessible ❤️ however, the food is cold when it's served and the coffee and tea is in the disposable cup, maybe because it's a set or it's their signature. We didn't have breakfast hoping to enjoy the food here. The pineapple is also not fresh 😔. They are also like in a hurry asking you if you're done or not😅 want to take the tray immediately.  I'm not sure if they served pasta. I better order pasta next time ❤️ over all is still okay🙂

TB-2200 with service charged. Good for 4.
